notes: Simulation: slicing soap, slime and fruit to earn coins and buy better tools is an earn-and-upgrade loop, the clicker end of the genre, with ASMR as theme rather than a second genre. The author's answers close stage B — one main station inside a small minimalist studio, the tool shop is an on-screen menu rather than a counter, and no unlockable areas — which leaves nowhere to walk, so the ASMR bench is the subject and the pastel studio is its setting: set-display, and SET alongside P0 so traversal segmentation and jump-gap checks are skipped while the room still gets built. No preset survived the trim: Incremental Simulator and Physics Sim both lose their shape and nearly all their options here (no storefront, no purchase gates, no circulation between stations), so I emit none and take physics-rig directly for the breakable soap, kinetic sand, slime, fruit and soft blocks whose reactions are the entertainment, plus trigger-task for the cutting station itself. Decided without a user: coins, leaderstats, DataStore and the UI are scripting concerns with no layout geometry, so nothing was emitted for them.
